csv_project_name: Design & CA for Midcrown Multi-Generational Center and Park
csv_scope_of_work: The City of San Antonio (City), Capital Delivery Department (CDD) is issuing a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) seeking Statement of Qualifications (SOQ) from interested professional architectural firms (Respondents) for the design and construction administration services for the Midcrown Multi-Generation Center and Park .The scope of work includes programming and design for a 16,000 SF Multi-generation Community Center and associated site development. The community center will provide programs to be determined during the facility design process and will be managed by the Department of Human Services (DHS), the Parks and Recreation Department, and or a combination of the two.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: Design and Construction Administration for Midcrown Multi-Generational Center and Park
short_description: Design services for a 16,000 SF community center and associated park site development.
project_scope: Programming, design, and construction administration for a 16,000 SF multi-generational community center with associated site development and park-related works. The facility program will be defined during design and managed by the Department of Human Services, the Parks and Recreation Department, or both.
services: Architectural design, programming, construction administration, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, civil engineering, structural engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project with structural engineering as part of a broader architectural team.
- Moderate size at 16,000 SF; no indication of long spans, special structures, or unusual structural systems.
- Primarily an architectural/community building project rather than a structurally ambitious sbp core project.
- Could offer teaming opportunity with architects, but limited evidence of innovation, sustainability, or complex engineering.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The listed contract value of 1.2M appears to refer to the design/services contract, not construction. Available scope information: 16,000 SF community center plus associated site development and park works.
fee_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as 'Contract Value: $1.2M'; interpreted as the professional services contract value for design and construction administration.
references_qualifications: Interested professional architectural firms are sought for RFQ/SOQ submission. Requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, structural engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and construction/project management. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
